description: This file contains Sass mixins and functions related to responsive breakpoints in Bootstrap, defining viewport sizes and media query helpers.

methods.name: breakpoint-next
methods.description: Returns the next breakpoint name after the given one based on the list of breakpoint names.

methods.name: breakpoint-min
methods.description: Returns the minimum width of a given breakpoint, or null if it is the smallest.

methods.name: breakpoint-max
methods.description: Calculates and returns the maximum width for a given breakpoint, usually the next breakpoint's min width minus a small offset.

methods.name: breakpoint-infix
methods.description: Provides an infix string for breakpoint-based utilities, empty for the smallest breakpoint.

methods.name: media-breakpoint-up
methods.description: Creates a media query applying styles at the given breakpoint and wider.

methods.name: media-breakpoint-down
methods.description: Creates a media query applying styles at the given breakpoint and narrower.

methods.name: media-breakpoint-between
methods.description: Creates a media query that applies styles between two breakpoints, inclusive.

methods.name: media-breakpoint-only
methods.description: Creates a media query exclusively within the specified breakpoint's range.
